subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'GREATR' is written as 'OZMIBZ', and 'POINTA' is written as 'XWQVBI'. How will 'FORTAP' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'GREATR' is written as 'OZMIBZ'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5014fd7c83f37410bc7ecfd90dd355a2706b954669e65de4a39318cc72c4c106.png] 

'POINTA' is written as 'XWQVBI'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b49a172e6e8468c786305d1142d9968f4abb2e2aa3773e88962de853dd170bb7.png] 

Similarly, for FORTAP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/450ad52bc34f9a0295dff729d53283f756ddbc17845c1e39388c3de3d8e9e675.png] 

So, 'FORTAP' will be written as 'NWZBIX'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
